label: L-03
title: emergencyWithdraw lacks nonReentrant guard — inconsistent with all other state-changing entry points; latent risk if vault token implements transfer callbacks
description: AYieldStrategy.emergencyWithdraw is decorated with onlyOwner but not nonReentrant. Every other state-changing external entry point uses nonReentrant. The asymmetry creates a gap: if the vault token implements ERC777 tokensReceived hooks, the owner's receiver contract gets control mid-transfer with the reentrancy mutex NOT held.
impact: Low probability for the intended sUSDe vault deployment (standard ERC20). Escalates to concrete risk for any future vault integration with transfer hooks.
attackPath: If vault token implements ERC777 tokensReceived, the owner's contract receives control mid-transfer
Reentrancy mutex is not held; second emergencyWithdraw call processes without revert
